hypotheses.justification: Neither the statement nor the proof uses this. `cocyclesOneCrossedIso` (DegreeOne.lean:451) and the things it is built from (`cocyclesOneIso`, `oneKerCrossedIso`) are defined with no JointlyContinuous assumption. The same holds for `mackeyConjugateCrossed`, `mackeyCoefficientHom` and `mackeyStabilizerToLeft` (Mackey.lean:321-373, 1445), and for Mathlib's `cochainsMap`/`cocyclesMap` (ContCohomology/Functoriality.lean, whose only variables are Ring/TopologicalSpace). The local instance `jointlyContinuous_mackeyStabilizer` would only fire if some term needed JointlyContinuous, and none does. The proof uses `cocyclesOneCrossedIso_hom_apply`, `mackeyConjugateCrossed_apply` (rfl), `HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i` and `cochainsMap_one_apply` (Mackey.lean:1466). None of them takes JointlyContinuous, so the same proof goes through unchanged.

No definition in the statement needs local compactness. That covers `cocyclesMap`, `cochainsMap`, `TopRep.homogeneousCochains`, `cocyclesOneCrossedIso`, `continuousCrossedHom` and `mackeyConjugateCrossed`. The lemmas the proof uses (`cocyclesOneCrossedIso_hom_apply`, `mackeyConjugateCrossed_apply`, `HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i`, `cochainsMap_one_apply`) don't take it either, so the same proof works without it.
Same reason as for `[LocallyCompactSpace H]`: no definition in the statement and no lemma in the proof needs it, so the same proof works without it.

Same reason as for `[LocallyCompactSpace H]`: `cochainsMap_one_apply` holds for any topological group J (here the stabilizer), with no local compactness. Nothing else in the statement or proof needs it, so the proof works unchanged without it.
